_comment: Kopilot texts, English (default and fallback). Flat keys, named placeholders {name} or {name:format}. Keys starting with log. are ILogger templates: keep the placeholder order. See docs/i18n.md.
language.name: English
tools.traffic.radiusLimited: Radius limited to {max} NM (200 km) – SimConnect doesn't accept more.
tools.traffic.noFlight: No flight loaded (main menu or loading screen).
tools.traffic.noOwnPosition: Own position unknown – traffic can't be computed relative to the aircraft.
tools.traffic.noResponse: MSFS didn't answer the traffic query. Is a flight running? Otherwise check kopilot_status.
tools.traffic.incomplete: MSFS didn't answer completely – some targets may be missing.
tools.traffic.noneMaybeDisabled: No traffic within {radius} NM. If that can't be right: AI traffic or multiplayer is probably turned off in the sim.
tools.traffic.noneAirborne: No airborne traffic within {radius} NM (only aircraft on the ground).
